title: Read receipt TODO is silent drop — misleads maintainer about feature status
description: SEC1 finding: In message.rs process_update, after update_read_at succeeds, code collects data for receipt enqueue but the TODO comment prevents it from actually executing. The code path looks complete but silently drops receipts. This violates the principle that code paths should clearly indicate their status. Fix: either implement the outbox enqueue for receipts, or remove the dead code and add a prominent comment at the function entry point explaining receipts are not yet implemented.
